xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3957: Overdeck-owned agent memory: project memory stored in the repo, replacing per-harness memory (Claude auto-memory)

plan.title: Overdeck-owned agent memory: project memory stored in the repo, replacing per-harness memory (Claude auto-memory)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Phase 1 is one vertical feature that crosses its natural seams once each: the store library, the index renderer, the three launch compositions (managed, Muse, dashboard preview, which docs promise match), the pan memory CLI door (which must regenerate the composer manifest and skill in lockstep), three pipeline predicates that would otherwise silently drop facts, the bundled rule, and docs. About 31 files, half of them the tests and docs that each slice must carry; the subsystem count is inflated by tests/, sync-sources/, configuration/ and root doc files. The separable remainder (import + native-memory switch) is already split into PAN-4577. Splitting further would ship either an injected index with no write door or a write door whose facts the pipeline loses.

narratives.Problem: Agent memory lives in each harness's own store. Claude Code auto-memory (~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/) is per machine, per user, per harness and invisible to the project; Codex, Pi, OMP and Kimi agents never see it, a second machine never sees it, and the project cannot review it. The operator works across several machines, so durable facts must travel with the repo through git.
narratives.Proposal: Add curated, one-fact-per-file memory in <planHome>/.overdeck/memory/<id>.md (operator facts per machine in ~/.overdeck/context/memory/), rendered at launch into a budgeted '## Project memory' / '## Operator memory' index in every managed harness's composition (managed launch, Muse, and the Context page preview). pan memory gains show/list/add/edit/retire and facts-first search as the single door; writes never commit, git and the PR are the curation. Home-directory paths are refused in the project store (D16), and .overdeck/memory/ is carved out of three pipeline predicates so facts survive pan done, sync-main and close-out (D17). A universal rule directs managed agents to pan memory add. Phase 2 (Claude import, native-memory switch) is PAN-4577.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Replacing or changing observation memory, its FTS index, prompt-time injection budgets or the SessionStart briefing
- pan memory import claude and memory.harness_native_memory (shipped by PAN-4577)
- Injecting fact bodies or per-prompt fact retrieval; a dashboard fact editor; capture hooks (phase 3)
- Committing, pushing or opening PRs on the author's behalf
- Reaching sessions already running; facts reach new sessions only
- Syncing the operator store between machines, or auto-pulling the primary checkout
- Storing any MEMORY.md or index file (the index is rendered at launch only)
- Reading, writing, moving or deleting anything under ~/.claude/
- Changing pan context diff
- Changing pipeline treatment of .pan/ or of any .overdeck/ path other than .overdeck/memory/
- Raising any row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt
- Running pan sync from the workspace build

autoDecisions.summary: Q1: project facts live in <planHome>/.overdeck/memory/<id>.md, committed on the code branch.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD-recommended option. Re-checked 2026-10-20: PAN-3998 is merged, .pan/ needs the same pipeline carve-outs, overdeck-state is archived (operator comment), and git check-ignore shows the path trackable in every registered project except dfai, where D11's guard refuses with the fix.

autoDecisions.summary: Q2: git is the curation; pan memory writes uncommitted files and never commits.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD-recommended option; the PR diff is the review and no second store or inbox state is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Q3: facts stay separate from the OKF bundle but use OKF-compatible frontmatter keys.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD-recommended option; OKF is opt-in, long-form and PR-gated in a second repo.

autoDecisions.summary: Q4/Q5 (native auto-memory switch and Claude import) are adopted as specified but delivered by child issue PAN-4577, filed 2026-10-20 and blocked on PAN-3957.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD's own phasing names P2 as a child; the combined plan exceeds the 25-file finalize lint; phase 1 already realizes the title (every harness gets the repo-owned index and the rule redirects writes), phase 2 is the cutover. This is a split, not a scope reduction.

autoDecisions.summary: Q6: operator-level facts live per machine in ~/.overdeck/context/memory/; syncing them across machines is a non-goal.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD-recommended option and the issue's 'user-level memory stays outside the repo'; the operator's multi-machine requirement applies to the project store, which travels through git.
PRD-recommended option; there is no code dependency, only launch-composition merge surface.

autoDecisions.summary: D16: project-store facts refuse home-directory absolute paths (/home/<u>/, /Users/<u>/, C:\Users\); /tmp/, localhost:<port> and 127.0.0.1 are allowed.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's 2026-10-20 comment requires machine-specific facts to stay out of the repo store; home paths can never be true on another machine, while dev ports and scratch conventions are often real project facts. Local keys are already refused by the D10 secret guard.

autoDecisions.summary: D17: carve .overdeck/memory/ out of the dirty-workspace gate, the pre-sync auto-commit reset, and close-out's merged detection.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified on origin/main: all three predicates treat .overdeck/ as disposable, so an uncommitted or fact-only change would be lost silently, defeating 'reach the other machines after a normal pull'.
